title: Data Quality Tests & Incremental Loads
summary: Write the data tests every warehouse relies on (not_null, unique, accepted_values, range, relationships), run them as a suite with error and warn severities, and load only new rows with a watermark.

hints.test_not_null: Treat None and empty or whitespace-only strings as null. Count failures and keep the first five row indices as a sample.
hints.test_unique: Count how often each non-null value occurs. Every row whose value occurs more than once fails, not just the second copy.
hints.test_accepted_values: A non-null value fails if it isn't in the allowed set. Nulls are not_null's job, so skip them here.
hints.test_range: Skip nulls. Fail values that aren't numbers, or that fall below min or above max. Either bound may be None.
hints.test_relationships: Referential integrity: every non-null child value must exist among the parent keys (put them in a set for O(1) lookups).
hints.test_result_shape_and_sample_cap: Every check returns {check, column, passed, failures, sample}, with sample holding at most 5 row indices.
hints.test_suite_severity: Only failures with severity 'error' make the suite fail. Count errors and warnings separately in summary.
hints.test_suite_rejects_unknown_check: Map check names to functions with a dict, and raise ValueError for a name you don't recognize.
hints.test_incremental_first_and_next_runs: With no watermark, take every row. Otherwise take rows with updated_at strictly greater than the watermark, sorted. The new watermark is the max updated_at seen.
hints.test_incremental_no_new_rows_keeps_water: An empty batch must return the old watermark unchanged, never None.
